title: Marcadores formales: furthermore, consequently, in conclusion

rule.title: Formal discourse markers
rule.explanation:
En reuniones, presentaciones y textos formales organizamos las ideas con marcadores:
- Para empezar y ordenar: «To begin with», «Firstly», «Secondly», «Finally».
- Para añadir: «Furthermore», «Moreover», «In addition» (además), «Additionally».
- Para la consecuencia: «Consequently», «As a result», «Therefore» (por consiguiente).
- Para introducir un tema: «Regarding» / «As regards» / «With regard to» (en cuanto a).
- Para contrastar dos puntos de vista: «On the one hand…», «On the other hand…»
- Para poner un ejemplo: «For instance», «For example».
- Para cerrar: «In conclusion», «To sum up» (en resumen).

Van al principio de la frase, seguidos de coma:
- «The site is simple. Furthermore, it loads in two seconds.»
- «Regarding the photos, we'll add a gallery.»

En una conversación informal suenan demasiado formales: con amigos se dice «also», «so» o «anyway».

Ojo: «In addition to» y «As well as» van con nombre o «-ing»: «In addition to being cheaper, it's faster».

answers: Regarding
As regards

answers: up

items.question: Por un lado… por otro…
options: On the one hand… On the other hand…
In one hand… In other hand…
items.explanation: «On the one hand… On the other hand».

sets.instructions: Une las frases con el marcador indicado o corrige el error.

items.source: The design is simple. It's very fast.
answers: The design is simple. Furthermore, it's very fast
The design is simple. Furthermore it's very fast

items.source: The site was slow. We lost customers.
answers: The site was slow. Consequently, we lost customers
The site was slow. Consequently we lost customers

items.source: About the photos: we'll add more.
answers: Regarding the photos, we'll add more
In addition to being cheaper, it's faster

answers: Regarding the budget, we need more time

answers: On the other hand, it might look cheap

answers: As a result, we changed the plan

answers: In addition to being faster, it's cheaper
